info.title: Face Emotion Backend
info.description: Classroom auth, meeting management, WebRTC signaling, Cloudinary and AI orchestration. WebSocket protocol: docs/API.md.

post.description: Register a student or an invited teacher; emails are case-insensitive.
Return short-lived access JWT and a rotating, single-use refresh JWT.

get.description: Return the user identified by the Bearer access token.

post.description: Atomically consume the refresh token and rotate both tokens.
Revoke this refresh session; access JWT remains valid until expiration.
Create a scheduled or ongoing classroom and enroll its owner.

get.description:
BE A history: teachers see hosted rooms, students see joined rooms.

Without ``page`` the data is a plain list (old FE contract); with ``page`` it is
``{items, pagination}``.

post.description: Resolve a room code and join atomically; no public participant directory.

get.description: Get meeting and membership states; reopening after a page exit rejoins (BE A).

put.description: Owning teacher edits name, description and tags; anyone else gets 404.

delete.description: Soft delete: hidden from history, detail and join; anyone but the owner gets 404.

post.description: Idempotently join; keep the same membership record when rejoining.
Mark membership left and close any active socket; retain the record.
Page exit (sendBeacon/keepalive): mark disconnected instead of leaving the room.
Owning teacher starts a scheduled classroom.
End the classroom, mark all memberships left and close room sockets.

BE A: save duration and mark the room as waiting for analysis (5-minute timeout).

Video analysis by the AI worker uses ``POST /meetings/{id}/recordings`` instead.
BE A: multipart image/video/audio recording attached to the room on Cloudinary.
Raw-body upload; visible to every member until the teacher changes sharing.

get.description: Members see unrevoked material shared with them; the owner sees everything.

post.description: Multipart upload; private until shared. Returns metadata plus a 5-minute download URL.

get.description: Filter by name, tag and upload date; newest first; paginated (BE A).

patch.description: [] shares with the whole class; ids add those members only.
[] hides from everyone; ids remove only those members.

post.description: Members and public links lose access; the file is kept for audit and restore.
Public link without login (1-168 hours); calling again replaces the old token.

get.description: No login: the token is the permission. 404 unknown, 410 revoked or expired.

post.description: Upload a raw video body (not multipart). RAM-only buffering with hard limits.

get.description: Get recording metadata, restricted to the meeting's owning teacher.
Generate a signed five-minute download URL for the authenticated asset.

post.description: Persist an analysis job. Idempotent while pending/processing/completed; failed jobs may retry.

get.description: Poll durable status every two seconds until completed or failed.

post.description:
Realtime inference (contract v1 §5.1): student, ongoing realtime meeting, frame in RAM only.

Same service and rate limit as the WebSocket FRAME message. AI failure still returns 200
with ``fail_detection``/``ai_error``; the next frame is the retry.
Deprecated alias of POST /meetings/{meeting_id}/emotions/infer (kept until 23/10).

get.description: Get recording analysis; return an empty report with current status when unavailable.

Weighted sample distribution. Auto prefers completed batch data, otherwise realtime; never merges sources.

``student_id`` narrows a multi-student room to one student's realtime samples.

post.description:
Signed parameters so the browser uploads straight to Cloudinary.

The real folder is always openemotion/uploads/{user_id}/{folder}; such files are not
attached to a meeting, so /media/{public_id} does not manage them.

get.description: Cloudinary details of a meeting's recording file (host or participant).

delete.description: Owner deletes the recording file; on storage failure the meeting keeps its reference.

get.description:
Segments [start, end) in seconds from the start of the video (contract v1 §5.3).

Owning teacher, after_session meeting, completed analysis only; otherwise 409 with
``details[0].data_status``. A range cuts segments to [from_seconds, to_seconds).

post.description:
Answer from the analysed timeline only (contract v1 §5.5).

Owning teacher, after_session meeting, completed analysis; otherwise 409 with
``details[0].data_status``. ``references`` are spans the FE can seek the video to.
Register a student by email; display_name becomes full_name.
OAuth2 password form (username = email). Raw token body so Swagger "Authorize" works.

delete.description: Media is removed first; if that fails the label is kept (BE A rule).

get.description: Liveness only; no external service requests.

delivered_to_teacher.description: Best-effort socket delivery; SQL record is authoritative
